t.zh: 这五句在真值表的每一行都为真。<part-ref to="lemma:auto"></part-ref>证得出几句？
t.en: These five sentences are true on every row of their truth tables. How many does <part-ref to="lemma:auto"></part-ref> prove?

t.zh: 搜不到证明，未必就没有证明：也可能是搜索的方法或深度不够。
t.en: A search that finds no proof does not show there is none: the method or the depth may fall short.

brief.zh: 设计一个证明助手：完成需要证明的测试目标，对指定的失败目标报告失败。
brief.en: Design a proof assistant that proves the required test goals and reports failure for the designated failure cases.

hint.zh: 用手里的 auto 逐句试，看哪几句证不出。
hint.en: Try each with the auto you have, and see which it cannot prove.
